message.content: In December, Los Angeles typically enjoys mild, comfortable weather. The average daily temperature hovers around **15 °C (59 °F)**, with highs usually in the low‑to‑mid 20s °C (70–75 °F) and lows in the mid‑10s °C (50–55 °F). It’s one of the cooler months of the year, but still far warmer than many northern U.S. cities.
